name: nds_2d
statement: The DS's two 2D graphics engines, A (registers 0x04000000-0x0400006F) and B (0x04001000-0x0400106F), drawn line by line into two 256x192 screens: display modes (off, graphics, VRAM display, main-memory FIFO), BG modes 0-6 with text, affine, extended (16-bit map, 256-colour and direct-colour bitmaps) and large-bitmap backgrounds, 4 and 8 bits per pixel, extended palettes, 128 OBJs per engine (tiled 1D/2D, bitmap, affine, double size, semi-transparent, OBJ window), windows 0/1/OBJ, alpha blending, brightness up/down, mosaic on text backgrounds, master brightness, and POWCNT1's screen swap. On engine A, BG0 in 3D mode shows the 3D engine's picture (scrolled by BG0HOFS, blended with the layer under it by its own alpha).

registers.name: DISPCNT
registers.bits: 0-2 BG mode, 3 BG0 is 3D (A), 4 tile OBJ 1D, 5 bitmap OBJ 256 wide, 6 bitmap OBJ 1D, 7 forced blank, 8-12 BG0-3/OBJ on, 13-15 windows 0/1/OBJ, 16-17 display mode, 18-19 VRAM display bank, 20-21 tile OBJ 1D boundary, 22 bitmap OBJ 1D boundary, 24-26 char base (A), 27-29 screen base (A), 30 BG extended palettes, 31 OBJ extended palettes

registers.name: BG0CNT-BG3CNT
registers.bits: 0-1 priority, 2-5 char base (16 KiB), 6 mosaic, 7 256 colours / bitmap, 8-12 screen base (2 KiB; bitmaps 16 KiB), 13 extended palette slot (BG0/1) or wraparound (BG2/3), 14-15 size

registers.name: BG2PA-BG2PD, BG2X, BG2Y (8.8 and 20.8 fixed point)
WIN0H, WIN1H, WIN0V, WIN1V, WININ, WINOUT

screen.layout: top screen then bottom screen, RGB888
screen.swap: POWCNT1 (0x04000304) bit 15: 1 = engine A on the top screen

limits: a line is drawn from the registers as they are when it starts (changes inside a line apply from the next); no display capture, no main-memory display FIFO (mode 3 shows black), no mosaic on affine backgrounds or OBJs, no OBJ cycle limit per line; colours blend in 5 bits per channel and master brightness works in 6
sources: GBATEK (DS video: display control, BG and OBJ, windows, blending, master brightness)
